name: cloudflare-ai-gateway
title: Cloudflare AI Gateway
description: Image generation and reference editing with interchangeable Cloudflare and Vercel AI Gateway adapters, a common request contract and explicit cost receipts.
docs: Install into a shadcn Next.js App Router project. Open /demos/cloudflare-ai-gateway. IMAGE_GATEWAY selects cloudflare (default) or vercel; Vercel requires AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY. Cloudflare supports byok, stored-byok and unified-billing. Receipts distinguish estimated log costs from reported Vercel generation costs. Registry source contains no host telemetry or usage gate.
